request.style: English, male tenor solo with choir, organ, strings, timpani, choral, solemn, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Eliashib the high priest began
Rebuilding the Sheep Gate again
They consecrated it with care
Set doors and bolted them there

[Verse]
Next to them Meremoth worked on
Repairs for the city strong
Meshullam son of Berechiah
Made repairs as the wall grew

[Verse]
Zadok son of Baana joined
Next to them their labor joined
Men of Tekoa made repairs
But nobles would not lift their cares

[Verse]
On the twenty-fifth of Elul
The wall was finished, it was full
In fifty-two days it stood
Against all the enemy’s mood

[Outro]
They knew it was our God
